IncidentCategoryCustomerFriendlyDescript: We regularly inspect trees near overhead power lines to keep your electricity supply safe and reliable. A recent inspection found some trees have grown too close to power lines. If unmanaged, branches could touch the overhead lines and cause unexpected interruptions to your electricity supply. We appreciate some customers may have experienced unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. We need to trim these trees, which requires a temporary power cut because the work cannot be done safely while electricity lines are live. Due to the amount of work required we will need to switch off your power for a longer period. This work is taking place on a Saturday to minimise the impact to affected customers. This essential work involves approximately 450 metres of tree cutting across 8 sections of the overhead electricity network. This work is taking place near Chain Road.

Steps.Message: We became aware of this power cut at 09:14. We’re sorry for any disruption this may have caused you. We didn’t know in advance there would be a power cut, but now that we know, our teams will do everything they can to get your power back quickly. Engineers in our control room have switched some customers power back on in your area. To get everyone’s power back on we may need to attend to investigate and make repairs. We’ll continue to update you until everyone’s power is back on.
Steps.Name: We are restoring customers automatically

Steps.Message: We have engineers on their way. As this is affecting your area, they will not need to attend your property. Rest assured once they arrive, they’ll work as quickly as is safely possible to get your power back on.
Steps.Name: Engineers on their way

IncidentCategoryCustomerFriendlyDescript: We've had to turn off power in your area so our engineers can safely carry out emergency repairs to the network.
PlannedIncidentReason: We're carrying out planned work in your area. For our engineers to carry it out safely they need to turn the power off. We're doing this work as it's essential to provide reliable electricity supplies to your area. We're sorry for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.
MainMessage: We are currently experiencing problems with the electricity supply in your area.  We are arranging to have engineers investigate the fault.  We are sorry we can't give you a time for the restoration of supply at present. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this may cause.
